acceptanceCriteria: Measure at least 20 rounds of N concurrent bare verify requests against one clean, repository-bound fixture using an external executable and preserve raw per-request results, order, exit codes, process counts, end-to-end latency, and environment identity.

Measure same-identity concurrent requests, distinct command identities, explicit failure propagation, cancellation or platform-unavailability, and resource-contention behavior; report execution count, total latency, queue/wait latency, and resource peaks as available or unavailable with reasons.
Inspect the production call graph and prove whether PhysicalSingleFlightCoordinator has a real caller; do not treat its unit tests or a synthetic coordinator invocation as production evidence.

Preserve repository isolation, Work Item and authorization boundaries, fail-closed behavior, deterministic evidence binding, and existing verification semantics; this Work Item must not modify Rust production code or weaken any gate.
Accept a future optimization hypothesis only if duplicate physical execution and a measurable target cost are demonstrated; otherwise record an explicit decline and the successor prerequisites.
Deliver reproducible measurement code, raw evidence, a three-language Work Item record, parity registration, correctness checks, platform limits, unknowns, and the final governance state.
goal: Measure whether concurrent verification requests for the same repository and command duplicate physical execution, and produce an evidence-backed accept-or-decline decision for a future coordinator integration without changing production governance behavior.
intent: Repository owner authorized continuation of the AI Cockpit performance initiative. Before wiring PhysicalSingleFlightCoordinator, measure the real concurrent verification request path and preserve the Calibrated Human-Agent Trust boundary.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Each independent CLI request preserves the same repository, command and Runtime identity; the observed physical execution count is recorded rather than inferred.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run at least 20 rounds with bounded concurrency against one clean fixture and retain ordered per-request receipts, exit codes and wall times.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Requests with different command identities are not counted as the same physical execution.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run paired concurrent requests with distinct explicit commands and bind command, Runtime and repository identities in raw evidence.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A failing command cannot produce a successful governance result or stale success receipt.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run a bounded concurrent failing command and preserve every exit code, stderr classification and absence or presence of receipt.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Cancellation either preserves the existing cleanup and timeout guarantee or is explicitly unavailable on the platform; no busy-wait or success claim is introduced.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Attempt one bounded cancellation run; record process-tree cleanup and mark platform-unavailable metrics explicitly when the platform cannot provide them.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Concurrent requests report execution count, total time, queue or wait time and resource peaks without filling unavailable metrics with zero.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Repeat the same-identity run at bounded concurrency and capture available process, CPU, memory and I/O metrics with reasons for unavailable values.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The evidence distinguishes real production callers from unit tests and synthetic coordinator invocations.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Search production crates and bind the exact caller inventory and source revision; retain existing coordinator tests as correctness evidence only.

sources: Human authorization: repository owner explicitly authorized continuation and pause/resume recovery on 2026-09-08; preserve the authorization and evidence boundary.
